F14.reason: jeffersonhealthcare.org resolves to CMS hospital 501323, but the 2023 AHRQ compendium links CCN 501323 to its own one-system record HSI00000526 (Jefferson Healthcare, hosp_cnt=2, sys_beds=25). The resolver's parent-system step would therefore resolve it to health_system, contradicting F14 gold (standalone_hospital). Replacement is a real independent hospital that is in CMS but in no AHRQ system: CCN 501313, CASCADE MEDICAL CENTER, LEAVENWORTH, WA.
